description: Fetch and shape data: load JSON or CSV from a public https URL, or take data written inline, then filter, pick, rename, compute, group and summarize, sort and join it. The output is the transformed data — usually a list of records. Successor to L0170.

example_prompts.prompt: From https://l0185.graffiticode.org/data/sales.csv, total the paid order amounts by region, largest first.
example_prompts.notes: Right to left: `sort-by ["revenue" DESC] summarize {revenue: [SUM "amount"]} group-by ["region"] where ["status" EQUALS "paid"] fetch "…" {}`.

example_prompts.prompt: List the names and emails of the users in https://l0185.graffiticode.org/data/api.json (they are under data.users).
example_prompts.notes: `at` goes to the RIGHT of fetch: `pick ["name" "email"] fetch "…" at "data.users" {}`.

example_prompts.prompt: Join each order to its customer's name.
example_prompts.notes: Bind the customers with `let`, then `join {with: customers on: ["customer-id" "id"] prefix: "customer-"}`.

example_prompts.prompt: Chart the data at this URL.
example_prompts.notes: Not this language: charts are L0184.
